name: Environment Variables
description: Masked secrets with a reveal, per-environment scope toggles, a .env paste that flags duplicates and invalid keys, and a redeploy banner after edits.

props.name: project
props.description: Project name in the header, in mono beside the accent dot.

props.name: variables
props.description: Keys with a sensitive flag, a relative updated time, per-environment scopes and stored values. Defaults to a ledgerline sample.

props.name: environment
props.description: Which environment is on screen. The switcher updates it too.

props.name: mask
props.description: Mask secrets until their reveal control is pressed. Plain values stay readable.

props.name: density
props.description: Row padding: 8px or 12px, tighter from the large container.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the project dot, a new key in a paste, and the redeploy mark.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next list after a scope edit or an import.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root section.
